name: Ayuntamiento de Malaga
verdict: The city council of Málaga sponsoring through its own name and mark; a Spanish municipal government with no record of serious abuses found.
note: Proposed none 2026-09-28 (PR #340): the sponsor is the city council itself (the 'marca Málaga' placed through municipal company Promálaga). State ownership alone is not a tier; no court, regulator, UN-body or major-NGO human-rights finding against the Ayuntamiento de Málaga was found, so nothing found.
